name: LangGraph Swarm
summary: LangChain's Python library for swarm-style multi-agent systems on LangGraph, where agents hand control to each other with handoff tools.
description: The swarm remembers which agent was last active and resumes with it; built-in handoff tools can be customized. `pip install langgraph-swarm` (PyPI 0.1.0, Dec 2025). MIT. Its sibling langgraph-supervisor-py is archived.
